requirement: v3.3.3: npm publication of 3.3.2 is impossible from our side because npm staged it (E409 Cannot publish over previously staged version); npm docs say a staged version shares the semver unique index but does not block publishing other versions, so bump the patch version and publish that (functionally identical to 3.3.2)

assertions.cause: the CI npm step left 3.3.2 in npm staged-publish state: the version is absent from the public packument (404) and any republish is refused with E409 Cannot publish over previously staged version
assertions.fix: version bumped to 3.3.3 (no functional changes); it will be published directly with a 2FA-satisfying interactive publish, so no staged placeholder can exist for it
assertions.note: CI should switch to Trusted Publisher (OIDC) or stop using a bypass-2FA granular token, otherwise every release risks staging instead of publishing
